title: GE dishwasher will not start despite lights
scope: General checks for an illuminated GE dishwasher that will not start; not a failed-part diagnosis.
safety: Do not bypass door interlocks or open electrical panels. Model-specific controls and unresolved faults require the manual or service.

title: GE refrigerator warm or not cooling enough
scope: General cooling checks; settings and installation requirements depend on the exact model.
safety: Disconnect power before maintenance. Use model-specific instructions; persistent cooling problems need professional service.

title: GE refrigerator or freezer door not closing
scope: General door closure checks; no hinge replacement procedure or compatibility claim.
safety: Do not force the door or attempt unsupported hinge repairs. Broken hinges require service.

title: GE refrigerator normal sounds and unusual noises
scope: Examples of normal operating sounds, not a diagnosis based on sound alone.
safety: Do not dismantle electrical or refrigerant components to investigate noise. Unexplained sounds require professional diagnosis.

title: GE dishwasher drainage checks
scope: General GE drainage guidance; not a model-specific diagnosis or parts compatibility record.
safety: Never put hands inside a disposer. Do not use drain cleaner in a dishwasher. Follow the specific installation manual; unresolved drainage problems require service.

title: Whirlpool dishwasher filter designs
scope: General guidance distinguishing filter designs; identify the actual model and filter before acting.
safety: Use the appliance's own manual to identify its filter design. Refit removed components correctly; do not apply instructions for one filter design to another.

title: Whirlpool refrigerator condenser care
scope: General condenser maintenance guidance; not a diagnosis of cooling failure or approval to dismantle a specific model.
safety: Disconnect electrical power before cleaning. Avoid disturbing water lines or damaging tubing and fins. Some models need no cleaning; others require a qualified technician.

title: Whirlpool refrigerator ice maker checks and water supply
scope: General ice maker temperature, shutoff arm, and water supply checks; not a part replacement guarantee.
safety: Disconnect power and shut off water before inspecting internal ice maker wiring or valves.

title: Whirlpool refrigerator water filter replacement and flushing
scope: General filter replacement intervals and air-flushing steps; confirm the exact filter cartridge for your model.
safety: Use only model-compatible cartridges and check for leaks after seating the filter.

title: Whirlpool refrigerator frost buildup and defrost guidance
scope: General moisture, door-seal, and defrost-system guidance; not a model-specific electrical diagnosis.
safety: Never use sharp metal objects to chip frost near evaporator coils; disconnect power before any internal service.

title: Whirlpool dishwasher drying performance and rinse aid
scope: General drying, rinse aid, and loading guidance; does not confirm a failed heating element.
safety: Allow the heating element to cool completely before touching the tub interior.

title: Whirlpool dishwasher odor and tub cleaning care
scope: General odor prevention and tub cleaning guidance; check model instructions for approved cleaners.
safety: Never mix bleach with acidic cleaners and never use hand dishwashing soap in a dishwasher.

title: GE dishwasher poor cleaning and spray arm checks
scope: General wash performance, water temperature, and spray arm clearance checks; not a parts fit proof.
safety: Verify water heater safety limits before adjusting hot water temperature; avoid scalding.

title: GE dishwasher leaking checks and leveling
scope: General door seal, detergent suds, and leveling leak checks; under-tub leaks require qualified service.
safety: Shut off electrical power and water supply before inspecting beneath a leaking dishwasher.

title: GE refrigerator water dispenser slow or not working
scope: General dispenser flow, filter, and frozen water line checks; confirm model-specific temperature settings.
safety: Disconnect power and shut off water before disconnecting internal water tubing.
